This year's second camp will be a bit of a change for regular participants and for us. We'll visit the nearby Šembera trails, whose profile of family-friendly and easier trails makes them the ideal place to train trail riding. We'll cover everything from theory to practice. We'll always have one trail to practise on, closed to the public during our coaching, before moving on to the next trail. Of course we'll try not only the descent but also how to get back up the hill with the least effort. It will also include practising basic technique and an off-road ride around the area.

LOCATION:

The Šembera trails are located beyond the village of Tuchoraz, just 3 km from the centre of Český Brod. The trails are suburban and currently have no car park directly by the trails. Visitors are asked to use the car parks in Český Brod. Parking right by the trails or blocking someone's driveway in the nearby village won't do anything for the good reputation of cyclists and the project. Source: www.semberskestezky.cz

Meeting point: 50.042896, 14.841354 – https://goo.gl/maps/wGrZLMMHDNBe1aR6A
Personal belongings can be stored in our team vehicle.

Parking for participants is possible along the main road here: 50.04362397575582, 14.847312603645415
The road is wide here and allows parking along the side. Please don't park in the forest or on the meadow by the trail. It's prohibited.

(please don't block road traffic or others' exit from the car park)

SUITABLE FOR:

Women and girls aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (ideally also women). Groups will be divided by ability or focus. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (MTB) or an e-bike with switchable assistance, in good technical condition.
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  • We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  • Spare clothes.
  • We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  • Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  • Snacks, fruit and drinks.
  • Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).
  • Obstacles for practising basic skills and small facilities.

We'd love to write 'a great lunch with wine, beer or soft drinks', but you know how it is. We'll order food for delivery together from Damejidlo.cz

We ask all participants to take a Covid-19 test.

SATURDAY – 12 June

07:30 – 08:00  Riders arrive, registration and equipment check with bike setup

08:30 – 09:00  Introduction of instructors, information about the coaching and splitting into groups

09:00 – 13:00 Technique training and trail practice (blue / red) (about 1–1.5 hrs on each)

13:00 – 14:30 Workshop focused on the bike and equipment + lunch break, digestion and discussion (simply a chat)

14:30 – 18:00 Black trail practice (we'll see what you can do, or how to avoid it) and a ride

18:30 – 19:30 Camp review, tips and so on …

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away or, by arrangement, before the event (2–3 weeks). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
